## KultrDL 1.0.1

**Fixes playing and downloading.** In 1.0.0 the download engine (yt-dlp) couldn't start in the release build, so downloads failed with “ExceptionInInitializerError” and tapping a song closed the app. Both work again.

- **Engine start-up fixed.** The release build had stripped code the engine needs to unpack itself on first launch.
- **No more crash when a song can't play.** You get a short message saying why, and the next song plays.
- **Safe engine updates.** yt-dlp updates itself shortly after the app starts. The update now waits until nothing is using yt-dlp; before, a song started at that moment could fail.
- **Clear error messages.** For example “Sign in to confirm you're not a bot” instead of a Python traceback.
- **Tested on an emulator.** Every build now runs on an Android emulator: yt-dlp starts and updates, a shared link opens, plays and downloads as a tagged MP3.

## Install

Download the APK for your phone below — **arm64-v8a** fits nearly every recent phone; **universal** fits all of them but is larger — and open it. It installs over 1.0.0 and keeps your library. Requires Android 8.0 or later.
